text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win! Me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Nobody else! ME!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(Her energy... Her fire! It's like it's
blazing up from
deep, deep within...)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And Vodka takes first! Vodka has taken
the
crown with a stunning performance!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Awwwww YEAH! I did it! I really did it! I
beat
Machan!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The name's Vodka! Don't forget it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow! Did you see that?! What a run!
She's so
cool!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She actually won! Holy cow! Where's she
running
next?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
One thing's for sure, she's going to be an
A-lister
next year! Man, that was
something!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka pumps her fists and roars in
triumph. There
are so many spectators
watching her that you'd
think she was
the only Umamusume in the whole

racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...
Well, looks like you had it in you after
all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Ughhh!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Like I'm going to let her outdo me!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You got me, Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: We're changing strategies.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: For the next race. I was thinking that the Tulip Sho would be the best race to help get me ready for the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But Vodka just made a huge splash, and
I'm
pretty certain the waves reached
Scarlet as well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: A rising tide lifts all boats.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This wave may even return... to lift
Vodka herself.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, who do you think would win in a
race?
Vodka or Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm talking about the Tulip Sho.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
They haven't said yet. Vodka is having
trouble
choosing between the Classic
Triple Crown tour
and the Triple Tiara
tour.
choice_data_list: ...Did both of them say they were running?
...Did both of them say they were running?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tulip Sho is generally seen as a race
for
Umamusume who plan to run in the
Oka Sho
afterwards.
choice_data_list: Then, entering the Tulip Sho means—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Right, but I'll see to it that she enters. If
both of
them run, it'll be explosive. Like
fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks I can't set off alone. Fireworks
so
striking and dramatic that everyone
will look up
and watch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And then, just when the time is ripe, I'll
take the
stage—a stage set for the
biggest and most
glorious production.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, we should make my next
race the
Fillies' Revue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm having more trouble than usual
following her
logic... but she seems to
have made up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For better or worse, Aston Machan isn't
one to
take other people's opinions into
account.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the Fillies' Revue would be a
good
preliminary for the Oka Sho. It's
not a bad choice
at all.
choice_data_list: (She probably wouldn't listen even if I objected.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's decided—our next race is the Fillies'
Revue. I
just hope that someday Aston
Machan will let me
know what's going on
in her head.
